u.del_flag = '0'

SELECT user_id, username, password, nickname, phone, email, dept_id, status, pwd_reset_flag, lock_status, lock_time, last_login_ip, last_login_time, pwd_update_time, version, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT user_id, username, password, nickname, phone, email, dept_id, status, pwd_reset_flag, lock_status, lock_time, last_login_ip, last_login_time, pwd_update_time, version, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status = '0' WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms <> ''
SELECT r.role_key FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.del_flag = '0'
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
